hance.definition:
v. t. To raise; to elevate.
 Alt. of Hanch
hance.translation: n. 拱腰, 椭圆拱脚尖最短半径的弧

hancock.definition: n. American revolutionary patriot who was president of the Continental Congress; was the first signer of the Declaration of Independence (1737-1793)
hancock.translation: n. 全民超人（电影名）；汉考克

hancock's amputation.translation: [医] 汉考克氏切断术(足切断术的一种)

hancock's operation.translation: [医] 汉考克氏手术(一种切肢术)
